notes.added_text: Maybe I should write that post about how I got an extra sensory input from a high pitch noise in really fucking broken Mercedes 190E. After I fixed the problem, I had the worst migraine in my life after driving the said car for 1 hour, because my brain could not adapt to the fact that "oh, this high pitch sound that was directly correlated to the current speed and some other parameters is now gone". \nI could genuinely drive that thing without ever looking at the instrument cluster, because I could intuitively infer all necessary values from that auditory input. No other car ever felt so personal. I've built a brain-shitbox-interface and I've lost it.

#Disturbed and conflicted to confirm the computerfuckers are once again correct #Never been elbow deep in my own fully numb optic nerve before but I imagine a similar psychological sensation #(Heeby jeebies)
